subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should maintainers retire this stale local-auth-client branch in favor of the current-main `@anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk` 0.19.0 provider graph, or sponsor a refreshed local client implementation?
rationale: The central dependency problem is now addressed on current main by a different package-level path, while accepting this PR would still make an auth-provider behavior choice and require a non-trivial branch refresh.

options.title: Retire After Main-Line Verification
options.body: Verify a current-main Node 25+/26 Anthropic Vertex ADC turn or audit package install, then close or supersede this protected PR with the main-line SDK upgrade path.

options.title: Refresh The Local Client
options.body: Ask for a rebased PR that keeps the provider shrinkwrap, declares provider-owned runtime dependencies, preserves cache-control behavior, and supplies live Vertex proof.

options.title: Keep Paused For Ownership Review
options.body: Leave this PR open only if maintainers still want to compare the official SDK upgrade against a local auth-client replacement before deciding.

recommendation.title: Retire After Main-Line Verification
recommendation.body: Verify a current-main Node 25+/26 Anthropic Vertex ADC turn or audit package install, then close or supersede this protected PR with the main-line SDK upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the clearest current routing candidate from the release/provider package history and prior automerge request on this PR.
